stem.text: What is **not** a statement of one of Newton’s laws of motion?

A.text: If body X exerts a force on body Y, body Y exerts an equal and opposite force on body X.

B.text: If no resultant force acts on a body it has constant velocity.

C.text: The rate of change of momentum of a body is proportional to the resultant force acting on it and takes place in the direction of the force.

D.text: The total momentum of a system of interacting bodies is constant if there is no external force.
